components.source carriers: System process,registered strategies,resource bound,schedules,security states and stopping states. rowMeaning proves exact source strategy/schedule/resource admission.
components.complete outcome ledgers: favorableMeaning and unfavorableMeaning identify every admitted secure/insecure final-state row; outcomeExhaustion and outcomeDisjoint establish complete exclusive classification.

components.source extension: rowExtension,favorableExtension,unfavorableExtension,extendExecution and extendStopped preserve earlier source rows,outcomes and stopped traces under registered support/resource extension.
components.grammar and controls: Complete original256 candidates,three witnesses,four controls,every source program field/hash and unknown-ID rejection match pinned V3.
